blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Feed-forward 4D driving-scene reconstruction enables efficient modeling of dynamic autonomous-driving scenes, but current methods suffer from two complementary failure modes: semantic leakage of traffic participants into the static representation and geometric drift of Gaussian locations across viewpoints. We propose \textbf{IGRecon4D}, a feed-forward dynamic scene reconstruction framework that addresses these failures with training-time instance-prior distillation and LiDAR-anchored Gaussian positioning. Specifically, an instance-level semantic branch provides a potentially dynamic participant prior, which is distilled into dynamic-mask learning through the Instance-Dynamic Consistency Constraint to encourage high-recall localization of traffic-participant regions prone to dynamic-static leakage. In parallel, sparse LiDAR measurements guide dense depth estimation, and the resulting depths are back-projected to anchor Gaussian positions for improved multi-view geometric consistency. Experiments on the Waymo Open Dataset and zero-shot evaluation on nuScenes demonstrate improved full-image reconstruction on the main benchmark and stronger traffic-participant-region reconstruction under cross-dataset evaluation.
blocks.zh: Feed-forward 4D驱动相机场重建能够高效地模拟动态自动驾驶相机场景,但目前的方法有两种互补的故障模式:交通参与者的语义渗入到高斯地点的静态表现和几何漂移到不同角度. 我们提出\textbf{IGRecon4D},这是一个向导的动态场景重建框架,它通过培训时间实例前蒸馏和LiDAR-anchored Gaussian定位来解决这些故障。 具体地说,一个实例级语义分支提供了潜在的动态参与者先行性,通过实例-动态一致性约束被分解成动态任务学习,鼓励交通参与区高召本地化,容易发生动态-静态渗出. 平行地,稀疏的LiDAR测量指导了密度深度估计,所形成的深度被后期预测为锚地高斯位置,以提高多视图几何一致性. 对Waymo开放数据集的实验和对nuScens的零镜头评价表明,在跨数据集评价下,主要基准的全面图像重建得到了改进,交通参与区重建得到加强。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Dynamic scene reconstruction aims to recover time-varying 3D scenes from visual observations, which is essential for autonomous driving, simulation, and embodied perception. Early implicit methods such as NeRF-based dynamic reconstruction [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] model spatiotemporal variations through neural fields, while explicit methods such as 3D Gaussian Splatting [ 4 ] and its dynamic extensions [ 5 ] improve rendering efficiency with Gaussian primitives. However, these methods typically rely on costly per-scene optimization, limiting their scalability to long driving sequences and large-scale datasets.
blocks.zh: 动态场景重建旨在从视觉观测中恢复时断时续的3D场景,这对于自主驾驶,模拟,以及体现的感知都是必不可少的. 早期隐含的方法如基于NERF的动态重建[1,2,3]模型通过神经场瞬间变换,而3D高斯电镀[4]及其动态扩展[5]等明确的方法则与高斯原始人提高了渲染效率. 然而,这些方法通常依赖于昂贵的人均场景优化,将其可扩展性限制在长驱动序列和大型数据集上.

blocks.en: To reduce per-scene optimization, feed-forward geometric estimation methods have emerged as an efficient alternative. Unlike traditional SfM pipelines such as COLMAP [ 6 ] , these methods directly predict geometric information from one or multiple input views through a single network forward pass. Representative methods such as DUSt3R [ 7 ] , VGGT [ 8 ] , and π 3 \pi^{3} [ 9 ] have shown strong geometric prediction ability, providing a foundation for recent feed-forward reconstruction methods.
blocks.zh: 为了减少每片场景的优化,出现了一种高效的替代饲料前几何估计方法。 与传统的SfM管道如COLMAP[6]不同,这些方法通过单一的网络前传直接预测从一个或多个输入视图得到的几何信息. DUST3R [7], VGGT [8], 和\\ 3\pi^{3} [9] 等代表性方法都显示出强烈的几何预测能力,为最近的向导重建方法奠定了基础.

blocks.en: Building on these advances in feed-forward geometric estimation, recent methods further predict Gaussian primitives in a feed-forward manner. In recent years, large reconstruction models (LRMs) [ 10 ] based on the Transformer architecture have demonstrated remarkable progress in 3D reconstruction, particularly multi-view reconstruction methods built upon the Vision Transformer (ViT) [ 11 ] . Furthermore, several studies have extended feed-forward reconstruction to Gaussian-based scene representations, including Flash3D [ 12 ] , MVSplat [ 13 ] , NoPoSplat [ 14 ] , AnySplat [ 15 ] , and DepthSplat [ 16 ] . These methods achieve efficient 3D reconstruction and high-quality rendering but are primarily designed for static scenes.
blocks.zh: 在饲料前进几何估计的这些进步的基础上,最近的方法进一步以饲料前进的方式预测高斯原始人. 近年来,基于变形金刚架构的大型重建模型(LRM)[10]在3D重建中显示出显著的进步,特别是基于变形金刚(ViT)的多景重建方法[11]. 此外,多项研究还将Flash3D [12],MVSplate [13],NoPoSplate [14],AnySplate [15],和深度Splate [16] 等基于高斯的场景表现方式扩展了向前进的重建. 这些方法实现了高效的3D重建和高质量的渲染,但主要是为静态场景设计的.

blocks.en: For dynamic scenes, recent efforts have begun to explore feed-forward 4D reconstruction. L4GM [ 17 ] introduced the first feed-forward framework for 4D Gaussian reconstruction, but it mainly focuses on object-level modeling and does not readily generalize to complex scene-level reconstruction. Subsequently, STORM [ 18 ] proposed a feed-forward framework for dynamic scene reconstruction, significantly improving reconstruction efficiency. DGGT [ 19 ] further extends feed-forward reconstruction to multi-view autonomous driving scenarios. Nevertheless, existing feed-forward dynamic reconstruction methods still face difficulties in complex scene-level autonomous driving scenarios, where accurate geometry, multi-view consistency, and reliable localization of traffic-participant regions are all required.
blocks.zh: 对于动态场景,最近的努力已经开始探索向前进的4D重建. L4GM [17] 引入了4D高斯重建的第一个向导框架,但它主要侧重于对象级模型,并不容易概括到复杂的场景级重建. 随后,STORM [18] 提出了动态场景重建的向导框架,大大提高了重建效率. DGGT [19] 进一步将向导重建扩展到多景自主驱动情景. 尽管如此,在复杂的场景一级自主驾驶的情况下,现有的向前进动态重建方法仍然面临困难,需要准确的几何、多景一致性和可靠的交通参与区域本地化。

blocks.en: Beyond geometry and appearance reconstruction, several feed-forward reconstruction methods also predict additional scene modalities such as instance segmentation. IGGT [ 20 ] and EPS3D [ 21 ] predict instance-level semantics through feature clustering, while SegVGGT [ 22 ] further improves segmentation quality with a query-based formulation. However, these methods rarely exploit instance-level semantic cues to improve reconstruction itself. We use such cues as a potentially dynamic participant prior for high-recall localization of traffic-participant regions that are prone to dynamic-static leakage.
blocks.zh: 除了几何学和外观重建外,几种向前进的重建方法还预测了实例分割等更多场景模式. IGGT [20] 和 EPS3D [21] 通过特征集群预测实例级语义,而 SegVGGT [22] 则通过基于查询的配体进一步提高分区质量. 然而,这些方法很少利用实例一级的语义提示来改善重建本身。 我们使用这种提示作为潜在的动态参与者,然后对容易发生动态静态渗漏的交通参与区域进行高召本地化。

blocks.en: Building upon these observations, we propose IGRecon4D , a feed-forward framework for dynamic scene reconstruction that jointly addresses Gaussian prediction and traffic-participant-region localization. Our method employs a ViT [ 11 ] encoder followed by a series of alternating attention layers to extract hierarchical scene features, which are shared by both the reconstruction branch and the instance-level semantic branch.
blocks.zh: 基于这些观察,我们提出IGREcon4D,这是一个动态场景重建的反馈框架,共同解决高斯预测和交通参与地区本地化问题。 我们的方法使用一个VIT [11] 编码器,然后是一系列交替的注意层来提取等级的场景特征,这些特征由重建分支和实例级语义分支共同使用.

blocks.en: For dynamic scene reconstruction, a set of prediction heads is used to estimate Gaussian parameters and dynamic masks. To improve the geometric accuracy of the reconstructed scene, we further leverage LiDAR priors to predict more accurate depth, providing more reliable Gaussian positions. The predicted dynamic masks allocate traffic-participant regions that may cause dynamic-static leakage to per-frame Gaussians, while the remaining regions are accumulated into the static Gaussian set. During rendering, each frame is synthesized by jointly rendering the static Gaussians and the dynamic Gaussians corresponding to the current timestamp.
blocks.zh: 对于动态场景重建,使用一组预测头来估计高斯参数和动态口罩. 为了提高重建场景的几何精度,我们进一步利用LiDAR前身预测更准确的深度,提供更可靠的高斯位置. 预测的动态口罩分配了交通-参与者区域,这些区域可能导致动态-静态渗漏到每帧高斯人身上,而剩余的区域则被累积到静态高斯人组. 在渲染过程中,每个帧都通过联合渲染静态高斯人和动态高斯人对应当前时间戳来合成.

blocks.en: To improve traffic-participant-region reconstruction, we introduce an instance-level semantic branch that provides a potentially dynamic participant prior for dynamic Gaussian modeling. Specifically, the learned instance-level representations supervise dynamic mask prediction through an Instance-Dynamic Consistency Constraint, encouraging high-recall localization of traffic-participant regions that are prone to dynamic-static leakage.
blocks.zh: 为了改善交通-参与者-区域重建,我们引入了一个实例一级的语义分支,为动态高斯模型制作提供潜在的动态参与者. 具体地说,学习的实例层表现通过实例-动态一致性约束监督动态掩体预测,鼓励对容易发生动态-静态渗漏的交通参与区域进行高召本地化。

blocks.en: Extensive experiments on the Waymo Open Dataset demonstrate that IGRecon4D improves overall reconstruction quality, traffic-participant-region reconstruction, and novel-view consistency over representative feed-forward reconstruction baselines.
blocks.zh: 对Waymo开放数据集的广泛实验表明,IGREcon4D提高了总体重建质量、交通-参与-地区重建,以及新观点在代表性的饲料-前进重建基线上的一致性。

blocks.en: In summary, our main contributions are as follows:
blocks.zh: 总之,我们的主要贡献如下:

blocks.en: 1. We propose IGRecon4D , a feed-forward framework that unifies dynamic 4D Gaussian reconstruction and instance-level semantic learning for autonomous driving scenes.
blocks.zh: 一、导 言 我们提出IGREcon4D, 即一个向导框架,

blocks.en: 2. We introduce an Instance-Dynamic Consistency Constraint that exploits instance-level semantic cues as a potentially dynamic participant prior to supervise dynamic mask prediction, leading to improved high-recall localization and reconstruction of traffic-participant regions prone to dynamic-static leakage.
blocks.zh: 2. 国家 我们采用了一种实例-动态一致性约束,在监督动态遮罩预测之前,利用实例层面的语义提示作为潜在的动态参与者,从而改进了交通参与区高召本地化和重建,容易发生动态静态泄漏。

blocks.en: 3. We incorporate LiDAR-guided depth estimation to derive reliable Gaussian positions, enabling LiDAR-anchored Gaussian positioning and improving geometric accuracy and multi-view consistency as validated by novel-view synthesis and ablation studies.
blocks.zh: 3个 我们采用了LiDAR制导的深度估计,以得出可靠的高斯位置,使LiDAR-安乔雷德高斯定位得以实现,并改进几何精度和多视图一致性,这些都得到了新观点综合和激发研究的验证.

blocks.en: 4. Extensive experiments on Waymo and zero-shot nuScenes evaluation demonstrate improved full-image reconstruction on the main benchmark and stronger cross-dataset traffic-participant-region reconstruction.
blocks.zh: 4个 有关Waymo和零镜头nuScens评价的广泛实验表明,主要基准上的全面图像重建有所改善,跨数据集交通-参与者-区域重建更加有力。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Optimization-based Reconstruction
blocks.zh: 2.1 基于优化的重建

blocks.en: Dynamic 3D scene reconstruction aims to recover the geometry, appearance, and temporal motion of a scene from monocular or multi-view videos. Compared with static reconstruction, this task must additionally handle moving objects, occlusions, and temporal consistency across frames. Early RGB-D reconstruction methods exploit depth measurements for non-rigid geometry recovery [ 23 ] , but their performance depends heavily on sensor quality and often degrades under occlusion, rapid motion, or noisy depth observations.
blocks.zh: 动态3D场景重建旨在从单景或多景视频中恢复场景的几何,外观和时间运动. 与静态重建相比,这项任务必须额外处理移动对象,隐蔽物,以及跨帧的时间一致性. 早期的RGB-D重建方法利用深度测量来进行非刚性几何恢复[23],但其性能严重依赖于传感器质量,并经常在隐蔽,快速运动,或噪音深度观测下降解.

blocks.en: Neural scene representations have significantly advanced dynamic reconstruction [ 24 ] . NeRF-based methods [ 1 ] commonly model dynamics by introducing time-dependent deformation fields or canonical-space mappings, as in D-NeRF [ 2 ] , NeRFies [ 25 ] , and Neural 3D Video [ 26 ] . More recently, dynamic Gaussian-based methods build upon 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) [ 4 ] by introducing temporal parameters or motion-aware Gaussian representations [ 27 , 28 , 29 ] . These representations improve rendering efficiency and dynamic-scene fidelity, but they still typically rely on per-scene optimization, which limits their scalability to large autonomous-driving datasets.
blocks.zh: 神经场景表现显著推进动态重建[24]. 以NERF为基础的方法[1]通过引入时间依赖的变形场或舟-空绘图来常见的模型动力学,如D-NERF[2],NERFies[25],和神经3D视频[26]. 最近,动态高斯学方法基于3D高斯学镀层(3DGS)[4],引入时间参数或运动感应高斯学代表[27,28,29]. 这些表示方式提高了渲染效率和动态场景的忠诚度,但是它们仍然通常依赖于每个场景的优化,这限制了它们的可扩展性,只局限于大型自主驾驶数据集.

blocks.en: To improve geometry and temporal consistency under sparse observations [ 30 ] , recent dynamic reconstruction systems incorporate additional visual priors such as depth, optical flow, tracking, and semantic or instance cues [ 5 , 31 , 32 , 33 , 34 , 35 ] . These priors help resolve ambiguities in dynamic regions, but they are often integrated through multi-stage pipelines, for example, sequentially estimating depth or flow before reconstruction, resulting in additional system complexity and computational cost. This motivates reconstruction frameworks that can combine efficient feed-forward inference with reliable geometric cues and high-recall localization of traffic-participant regions.
blocks.zh: 为了在稀少的观测下改善几何学和时间一致性[30],最近的动态重建系统包含更多的视觉前兆,如深度、光学流、跟踪、语义或实例提示[5、31、32、33、34、35]。 这些前科有助于解决动态区域的模糊性,但它们往往通过多阶段管道进行整合,例如,在重建前依次估计深度或流量,从而导致系统复杂性和计算成本增加。 这促使重建框架能够把高效率的向导推论与可靠的几何提示和交通参与地区的高召本地化结合起来。

blocks.en: 2.2 Feed-forward Neural Reconstruction
blocks.zh: 2.2 进食神经重建

blocks.en: Feed-forward 3D reconstruction aims to directly predict scene representations, such as NeRFs [ 1 ] or 3D Gaussian primitives [ 4 ] , through a single forward pass of a neural network, thereby eliminating the costly per-scene optimization required by conventional reconstruction methods. Compared with optimization-based approaches, feed-forward methods offer significantly higher inference efficiency and stronger cross-scene generalization, making them an increasingly important research direction in recent years.
blocks.zh: Feed-forward 3D重建旨在通过神经网络的单一前传直接预测场景表现,如NERFs[1]或3D高斯原始人[4],从而消除常规重建方法所要求的昂贵的人均场景优化. 与基于优化的方法相比,向导方法提供了显著更高的推论效率,更强的跨场面概括,使得它们成为近年来越来越重要的研究方向.

blocks.en: An important precursor to feed-forward 3D reconstruction is feed-forward geometric estimation [ 36 ] , which aims to recover scene geometry with a single neural network forward pass. Unlike traditional per-scene SfM pipelines such as COLMAP [ 6 ] , these methods take one or multiple images as input and directly predict geometric information such as depth maps, point maps, camera poses, or tracks. DPT [ 37 ] estimates dense depth from a single image with a ViT-based architecture, while DUSt3R [ 7 ] extends feed-forward geometric reconstruction to two input views and enforces two-view geometric consistency. VGGT [ 8 ] further supports reconstruction from more input views and jointly estimates depth, camera poses, and tracks, whereas π 3 \pi^{3} [ 9 ] decouples reconstruction from the ordering of input views, improving the robustness of feed-forward geometric prediction. These methods provide effective geometric priors for 3D reconstruction and motivate subsequent feed-forward methods to move beyond geometry prediction toward renderable 3D representation reconstruction.
blocks.zh: 向导3D重建的一个重要前身是向导几何估计[36],其目的是用单一神经网络向前传恢复场景几何. 与传统的单场SfM管道如COLMAP[6]不同,这些方法将一个或多个图像作为输入,直接预测几何信息,如深度图,点图,相机姿势,或轨迹. DPT[37]从一个具有基于Vit架构的单一图像估算密度深度,而DUST3R[7]则将feed-forward几何重建扩展至两个输入视图,并强制二视图几何一致性. VGGT [8] 进一步支持从更多输入视图中进行重建,并共同估计深度,相机姿势,以及音轨,而 ^ 3\pi^{3}[9] 将重建与输入视图的顺序脱钩,提高向导几何预测的稳健性. 这些方法为3D重建提供了有效的几何前兆,并激励随后的向导方法从几何预测转向可变的3D表示重建.

blocks.en: Building on this direction, early feed-forward reconstruction methods mainly focus on object-level reconstruction. Representative approaches such as LRM [ 10 ] and LGM [ 17 ] learn ViT-based reconstruction priors and can efficiently recover high-quality 3D representations from only a few input views. By learning rich geometric priors from large-scale datasets, these methods substantially improve reconstruction speed while maintaining competitive reconstruction quality. More recently, feed-forward reconstruction has been extended from object-level to scene-level modeling. Methods such as Flash3D [ 12 ] , MVSplat [ 13 ] , NoPoSplat [ 14 ] , DepthSplat [ 16 ] , and AnySplat [ 15 ] leverage feed-forward prediction of 3D Gaussian representations to achieve an effective balance between reconstruction quality and computational efficiency. Unlike optimization-based Gaussian reconstruction methods, these approaches directly infer Gaussian parameters from input observations, enabling efficient scene reconstruction and rendering. Nevertheless, they are primarily designed for static scenes and cannot be readily generalized to dynamic environments.
blocks.zh: 在这个方向上,早期的饲料前进重建方法主要侧重于对象级重建. LRM[10]和LGM[17]等代表性方法学习基于ViT的重建前身,能从仅少数输入视图中有效恢复高质量的3D表示. 这些方法通过从大型数据集中学习丰富的几何前科,大大提高了重建速度,同时保持了竞争性的重建质量. 最近,向导重建已从对象级扩大到场景级建模. Flash3D [12],MVSplate [13],NoPoSplate [14],深度Splate [16],AnySplate [15] 等方法,利用3D高斯表示法的进取预测,实现重建质量和计算效率之间的有效平衡. 与基于优化的高斯重建方法不同,这些方法直接从输入观测中推断出高斯参数,使得高效的场景重建和渲染成为可能. 尽管如此,它们主要是为静态场景设计的,不能轻易被普遍化为动态环境.

blocks.en: To address dynamic scene reconstruction, recent studies have begun to investigate feed-forward 4D scene modeling. L4GM [ 17 ] introduced the first feed-forward framework for 4D Gaussian reconstruction, demonstrating the feasibility of directly predicting dynamic Gaussian representations. However, its design mainly targets object-level reconstruction and does not readily generalize to complex scene-level environments. More recently, DrivingForward [ 38 ] , STORM [ 18 ] , NoPo4D [ 39 ] , 4DGT [ 40 ] , DrivingRecon [ 41 ] , DrivingScene [ 42 ] , DynamicVGGT [ 43 ] , and StreetForward [ 44 ] have extended the feed-forward paradigm to dynamic scene reconstruction, significantly alleviating the computational burden of per-scene optimization.
blocks.zh: 为了解决动态场景重建问题,近期的研究已经开始调查向前进的4D场景建模. L4GM [17] 引入了4D高斯重建的第一个向导框架,展示了直接预测动态高斯表示的可行性. 然而,它的设计主要针对对象级重建,并不容易概括到复杂的场景级环境. 最近,DriverForward [38],STORM [18],NoPo4D [39],4DGT [40],DriverRecon [41],DriverScene [42],DynamicVGGT [43],和StreetForward [44]将向导模式扩展到动态场景重建,大大减轻了每场景优化的计算负担.

blocks.en: DGGT [ 19 ] is closely related to our setting, as it supports feed-forward dynamic reconstruction from multi-view autonomous-driving videos. Nevertheless, existing feed-forward dynamic reconstruction methods still face difficulties in complex driving scenes, where accurate geometry, multi-view consistency, and traffic-participant-region localization are all required. In particular, insufficient localization of traffic-participant regions can cause regions prone to dynamic-static leakage to be modeled as static content, while inaccurate geometry weakens cross-view consistency. Overall, dynamic-static separation remains a central challenge for dynamic reconstruction methods, since the ability to disentangle and model moving objects and the static background is critical to the final reconstruction quality.
blocks.zh: DGGT [19] 与我们的设定密切相关,因为它支持从多视图自动驾驶视频中进行向导动态重建. 尽管如此,在复杂的驱动场景中,现有的向前进动态重建方法仍然面临困难,在这些场景中,精确的几何,多景一致性,以及交通-参与者-区域本地化都是必要的. 特别是,交通参与区域局部化不足,可导致易发生动态静态渗漏的区域被模型化为静态含量,而不准确的几何则削弱了交叉视野的一致性. 总体而言,动态-静态分离仍然是动态重建方法的核心挑战,因为分散和模拟移动物体的能力和静态背景对最终重建质量至关重要。

blocks.en: 2.3 Joint Geometric Reconstruction and Multimodal Prediction
blocks.zh: 2.3 联合几何 重建和多式联运预测

blocks.en: Some feed-forward reconstruction methods go beyond scene reconstruction by predicting additional modalities, such as instance segmentation, while inferring scene geometry and appearance in a single forward pass. Built upon the feed-forward architecture of VGGT [ 8 ] , IGGT [ 20 ] and EPS3D [ 21 ] reconstruct the scene and obtain instance segmentation by predicting instance features and clustering them. To alleviate the segmentation degradation caused by the instability of clustering-based methods, SegVGGT [ 22 ] adopts a query-based formulation commonly used in instance segmentation and queries multi-level features to further improve segmentation quality. Although these methods predict instance-level information during reconstruction, the interaction between different modalities remains limited. MVGGT [ 45 ] further takes an additional text prompt as input and localizes the corresponding target in static scenes, while G 2 ​ T ​ A ​ M G^{2}TAM [ 46 ] extends this capability to dynamic scenes. These methods show that feed-forward reconstruction can be extended toward multimodal scene understanding; however, they do not fully exploit auxiliary modalities such as instance segmentation to improve reconstruction itself. For dynamic scene reconstruction, we treat instance-level semantic cues as a potentially dynamic participant prior rather than true motion-state labels. Leveraging this prior for high-recall localization of traffic-participant regions that are prone to dynamic-static leakage can improve traffic-participant-region reconstruction and overall reconstruction quality.
blocks.zh: 一些向前进的重建方法超越了场景重建,预测了更多的模式,如实例分割,同时推断场景几何和外观在一次前传中. 建于VGGT[8],IGGT[20]和EPS3D[21]的向导架构上,通过预测实例特征和集群来重建场景并获得实例分割. 为了缓解集群方法不稳定导致的分解退化,SegVGGT[22]采用了在分解中常用的基于查询的配体,并询问多层次特征,以进一步提高分解质量. 虽然这些方法预测了重建期间的例级信息,但不同模式之间的互动仍然有限。 MVGGT [45] 进一步在输入时附加文字提示,并在静态场景中定位相应的目标,而G2 T A M G^{2}TAM [46] 将这种能力扩展至动态场景. 这些方法表明,向前进的重建可以扩展到对多式联运场景的理解;但是,它们并没有充分利用诸如实例分割等辅助模式来改善重建本身。 对于动态场景重建,我们把实例级语义提示作为潜在的动态参与者,在运动状态标签之前而不是真实状态. 在交通参与地区容易发生动态静态渗漏的地方化高召之前利用这一点,可以改善交通参与地区重建和整体重建质量。

blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: Figure 1: Overview of IGRecon4D. Given multi-camera videos, camera parameters, and sparse LiDAR depth maps, IGRecon4D predicts Gaussian attributes, LiDAR-anchored Gaussian positions, dynamic masks, and instance-level semantic masks. blocks.en: Given multi-camera videos, camera parameters, and sparse LiDAR depth maps from an autonomous driving scene, IGRecon4D reconstructs a dynamic 4D Gaussian representation in a feed-forward manner. The framework contains two coupled branches: a reconstruction branch that predicts Gaussian attributes, dynamic masks, and Gaussian positions derived from LiDAR-guided depth estimation, and an instance-level semantic branch that learns instance-level cues as a potentially dynamic participant prior for mask supervision. An overview of the proposed framework is illustrated in Fig. 1 .

blocks.en: The reconstruction branch first extracts hierarchical spatiotemporal features with a ViT backbone and alternating attention layers. It predicts Gaussian attributes and dynamic masks from these features, while dense depth estimated from sparse LiDAR measurements is back-projected to obtain geometrically reliable Gaussian positions. The resulting Gaussians are then decomposed into dynamic and static components and rendered with a differentiable rasterizer.
blocks.zh: 重建分支首先提取带有ViT骨干和交替关注层的层次spatiotoporal特征. 它从这些特征中预测高斯人的属性和动态面具,而从稀少的LiDAR测量中估计的密度深度则背向预测,以获得几何可靠的高斯人位置. 由此产生的高斯人随后被分解成动态和静态的组件,并用不同的光栅来制备.

blocks.en: The instance-level semantic branch shares the reconstruction features and predicts instance masks through learnable queries. During training, these instance predictions provide a potentially dynamic participant prior for dynamic masks through the proposed Instance-Dynamic Consistency Constraint (IDC), encouraging high-recall localization of traffic-participant regions that are prone to dynamic-static leakage. The following subsections describe the dynamic 4D Gaussian representation (Sec. 3.1 ), feed-forward Gaussian prediction and LiDAR-guided depth estimation (Sec. 3.2 ), dynamic-static rendering (Sec. 3.3 ), instance-level semantic learning (Sec. 3.4 ), and the two-stage training objectives (Sec. 3.5 ).
blocks.zh: 实例级语义分支共享重建特征,并通过可学习的询问预测实例口罩. 在培训期间,这些案例预测通过拟议的实例-动态一致性约束(IDC),在动态口罩之前提供了潜在的动态参与者,鼓励对容易发生动态静态渗漏的交通参与区域进行高召本地化。 以下小节描述了动态4D高斯表示(Sec. 3.1),向导高斯预测和LiDAR导深估计(Sec. 3.2),动态-静态渲染(Sec. 3.3),实例级语义学习(Sec. 3.4),以及两级培训目标(Sec. 3.5).

blocks.en: We first partition the input video into a sequence of image patches, which are then fed into a ViT encoder to extract visual representations. Following the design of VGGT [ 8 ] , each alternating attention block consists of a frame attention layer and a global attention layer. By progressively aggregating spatial and temporal information, these layers produce a set of hierarchical features, denoted by F attn F_{\mathrm{attn}} , which contains the outputs of every frame attention and global attention block.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Datasets and Evaluation Protocol
blocks.zh: 4.1 数据集和评价协议

blocks.en: We conduct comprehensive experiments on the Waymo Open Dataset [ 52 ] . The dataset covers a wide variety of driving scenarios, including urban streets, highways, and complex traffic environments, and contains abundant traffic participants (e.g., pedestrians, vehicles, and cyclists) under diverse illumination and weather conditions. These characteristics make it well suited for evaluating the generalization ability and robustness of dynamic scene reconstruction methods in challenging real-world scenarios.
blocks.zh: 我们在Waymo开放数据集进行全面实验 [52]. 该数据集涵盖各种各样的驾驶情景,包括城市街道,高速公路,以及复杂的交通环境,并包含众多的交通参与者(如行人,车辆,骑自行车者)在不同照明和天气条件下. 这些特点使它非常适合评价动态场景重建方法在挑战现实世界情景中的通俗化能力和稳健性.

blocks.en: During training, we use the entire training split, which consists of 798 scenes. Each scene contains approximately 190–200 consecutive frames, providing sufficient temporal information for learning dynamic scene representations. During evaluation, we report results on the validation split containing 202 scenes. Unless otherwise specified, all reconstruction methods are evaluated under the same validation split, input camera configuration, and metric computation protocol.
blocks.zh: 在训练期间,我们使用整个训练分裂,由798场景组成. 每个场景包含约190~200个连续帧,为学习动态场景表现提供足够的时间信息. 在评估期间,我们报告包含202场场景的验证分拆结果。 除非另有说明,所有重建方法都按照相同的验证分拆,输入相机配置,以及度量计算协议进行评估.

blocks.en: Before training and inference, we perform several preprocessing steps. To obtain instance-level semantic annotations, we employ SAM3 [ 53 ] to automatically generate instance masks for each scene. Specifically, language prompts corresponding to traffic participant categories, including pedestrian , vehicle , and cyclist , are used to extract the corresponding instances. These masks are used as a potentially dynamic participant prior rather than as ground-truth motion-state labels. In addition, we generate sky masks for every frame using LISA [ 54 ] . Benefiting from its language-guided semantic segmentation capability, LISA accurately identifies large semantic regions with weak texture, such as the sky, and produces reliable sky masks for supervision during training.
blocks.zh: 在训练和推论前,我们执行几个预处理步骤. 为了获得实例级语义说明,我们使用SAM3[53]为每个场景自动生成实例口罩. 具体来说,与交通参与者类别对应的语言提示,包括行人、车辆和骑自行车者,用于提取相应的实例。 这些口罩用作潜在的动态参与者,而不是地面真实运动状态标签。 此外,我们使用LISA[54]为每个帧生成天空面具. LISA得益于其语言引导语义分解能力,准确识别了天等纹理薄弱的大型语义区,并制作了可靠的天面具,用于训练期间的监督.

blocks.en: 4.2 Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 4.2 执行细节

blocks.en: Our training procedure consists of two stages. In the first stage, we train the instance-level semantic branch to learn instance-aware semantic representations. In the second stage, we leverage the learned semantic representations to improve dynamic scene reconstruction through the proposed Instance-Dynamic Consistency Constraint. Both stages are trained on eight NVIDIA B200 GPUs. Following DGGT [ 19 ] , we adopt the same data sampling strategy by uniformly sampling four frames from every consecutive 20-frame sequence captured by the three front-facing cameras. In both stages, the AdamW [ 55 ] optimizer is employed together with a linear warm-up schedule followed by cosine learning rate decay.
blocks.zh: 我们的训练程序包括两个阶段。 在第一阶段,我们培训实例层面的语义分支来学习实例意识语义表达. 在第二阶段,我们利用学到的语义表述,通过拟议的实例-动态一致性约束来改进动态场景重建。 两个阶段都接受了8个NVIDIA B200 GPU的培训. 在DGGT[19]之后,我们采用同样的数据取样策略,从三台前置相机所捕获的连续20帧序列中统一取样四帧. 在两个阶段中,AdamW [55] 优化器都与线性热速表一起使用,然后是余弦学习速率衰减.

We initialize the backbone with the pretrained VGGT [ 8 ] weights and perform LoRA [ 56 ] fine-tuning (rank = 32) on the alternating attention layers. Meanwhile, the cross-attention layers, self-attention layers, MLPs, and the instance prediction head are fully fine-tuned. We use 100 learnable instance query embeddings in the instance-level semantic branch. The learning rates are set to 6 × 10 − 5 6\times 10^{-5} for the LoRA parameters and 2 × 10 − 4 2\times 10^{-4} for the fully trainable parameters. We set λ cls = 0.5 \lambda_{\mathrm{cls}}=0.5 and λ inst = 1.0 \lambda_{\mathrm{inst}}=1.0 in this stage.

blocks.en: 4.3 Comparison with State-of-the-Art Methods
blocks.zh: 4.3 与最新方法的比较

blocks.en: We compare the proposed method with several representative feed-forward reconstruction approaches to comprehensively evaluate its performance on dynamic scene reconstruction. Specifically, the compared feed-forward methods include AnySplat [ 15 ] , STORM [ 18 ] , DGGT [ 19 ] , NoPo4D [ 39 ] , and DrivingForward [ 38 ] . For a fair comparison, all methods are evaluated using the same number of input frames, namely 20 consecutive frames captured by the three front-facing cameras. Comparisons with additional methods are provided in Appendix B.1 .
blocks.zh: 我们把拟议方法与若干有代表性的向前进的重建方法进行比较,以全面评价其在动态现场重建方面的表现。 具体地说,比较的向导方法包括AnySplate [15],STORM [18],DGGT [19],NoPo4D [39],以及驱动Forward [38]. 为了进行公平的比较,所有方法都使用同样数量的输入帧来评价,即由三台前置相机捕捉的20个连续帧. 附录B.1提供了与其他方法的比较。

blocks.en: Table 1: Quantitative comparison on the Waymo Open Dataset. Metrics are computed on the validation split under the same input-view and input-frame setting for all methods. Traffic-participant-region (TPR) metrics are computed on SAM3-generated traffic-participant masks, while full-image metrics are computed over all pixels.
blocks.zh: 表1:Waymo开放数据集的定量比较. 量度是根据所有方法的相同输入视图和输入框设置下的验证拆分法计算的。 交通-参与区域(TPR)的衡量标准用SAM3生成的交通-参与区域口罩计算,而全图像测量标准则用所有像素计算。

blocks.en: For quantitative evaluation, we report image quality, geometric consistency, and computational cost. Image quality is measured using PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS [ 51 ] . As shown in Table 1 , our method improves PSNR over the strongest baseline DGGT [ 19 ] by 2.58 dB and reduces LPIPS from 0.116 to 0.102, while also achieving a slightly higher SSIM. To assess geometric consistency with LiDAR observations, we additionally report the average per-scene depth root mean square error (D-RMSE). Following a protocol similar to DGGT [ 19 ] , we linearly align the depths rendered from the reconstructed Gaussians to sparse depths obtained by projecting LiDAR points, compute RMSE at pixels with valid sparse depth, and average the resulting per-scene errors. Our method achieves the lowest D-RMSE of 4.610, compared with 7.470 for DGGT. We also report the runtime and GPU memory usage of each method. Although our method does not have the lowest runtime or memory usage, it completes feed-forward dynamic Gaussian reconstruction in 16.20 s.
blocks.zh: 关于定量评价,我们报告图像质量、几何一致性和计算成本。 图像质量采用PSNR,SSIM,LPIPS[51]测量. 如表1所示,我们的方法将PSNR比最强基线DGGT[19]改进2.58 dB,并将LPIPS从0.116减少到0.102,同时实现略高的SSIM. 为了评估与LiDAR观测结果的几何一致性,我们额外报告了平均每层深度根平均平方差错(D-RMSE). 遵循类似DGGT [19] 的协议,我们线性地将重建后的高斯人所给出的深度与投影LiDAR点获得的稀疏深度对齐,以有效的稀疏深度计算像素上的RMSE,并平均得出产生的每层错误. 我们的方法实现了最低的D-RMSE为4.610,而DGGT则为7.470. 我们还报告每种方法的运行时间和GPU内存使用情况。 虽然我们的方法没有最小的运行时间或内存使用率,但它在16.20s完成向导的动态高斯重建.

blocks.en: We further conduct qualitative comparisons with existing feed-forward reconstruction methods. As illustrated in Fig. 3 , the compared methods exhibit noticeable differences in traffic-participant-region reconstruction and texture preservation. Specifically, DGGT [ 19 ] provides insufficient high-recall localization of traffic-participant regions that are prone to dynamic-static leakage, causing some pedestrians or vehicles to be absorbed into the static representation and degrading reconstruction quality. STORM [ 18 ] , DrivingForward [ 38 ] and NoPo4D [ 39 ] exhibit noticeable information loss during texture modeling, resulting in blurred surface details. Although AnySplat [ 15 ] achieves competitive performance on static scenes, its lack of explicit per-frame participant-region modeling makes it difficult to faithfully reconstruct traffic participants in dynamic environments.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步从质量上与现有的向前进的重建方法进行比较。 如图3所示,比较方法显示,在交通-参与者-区域重建和纹理保存方面有明显差异。 具体地说,DGGT[19]对交通-参与者地区提供的高召本地化不足,容易发生动态静态渗漏,导致一些行人或车辆被吸收到静态代表中,重建质量下降. STORM [18],驱动Forward [38] 和NoPo4D [39]在纹理建模过程中显示出明显的信息损失,导致表面细节模糊. 虽然AnySplate [15]在静态场景上实现了竞争性表现,但其缺乏清晰的每帧参与者区域模型化使得在动态环境中难以忠实重建交通参与者.

blocks.en: In contrast, our method derives more reliable Gaussian positions through LiDAR-guided depth estimation while better localizing traffic-participant regions that should be modeled by per-frame Gaussians. Consequently, it improves the reconstruction of both static backgrounds and traffic participants, such as pedestrians and vehicles, within a unified framework. This leads to clearer object boundaries and better geometric alignment, as further demonstrated by the qualitative results in Fig. 3 .
blocks.zh: 相反,我们的方法通过LiDAR制导的深度估计得出了更可靠的高斯立场,同时更好地将交通参与区域本地化,而这些区域应该由每帧高斯人模拟. 因此,它改善在统一框架内重建静态背景和交通参与者,如行人和车辆。 这导致对象边界更清晰,几何对齐性更好,图3的质量结果进一步证明了这一点.

blocks.en: Figure 3: Qualitative comparison on the Waymo Open Dataset. IGRecon4D better preserves traffic participants and static background details than feed-forward baselines, with fewer participant-region omissions and sharper object boundaries.

blocks.en: Qualitative comparisons are presented in Fig. 4 . As can be observed, DGGT [ 19 ] suffers from inaccurate depth estimation, causing noticeable geometric misalignment and spatial shifts of objects that should remain geometrically consistent under novel viewpoints. In contrast, our LiDAR-guided depth estimation derives more reliable Gaussian positions for LiDAR-anchored Gaussian positioning, resulting in improved geometric alignment and stronger structural consistency under novel-view rendering.
blocks.zh: 图4列出了定性比较。 可以观察到,DGGT [19] 的深度估计不准确,导致物体明显几何错位和空间变化,在新观点下,这些现象应保持几何一致性。 相比之下,我们的LiDAR导深估计为LiDAR-Anchored Gaussian定位得出了更可靠的高斯位置,从而在新观点渲染下改善了几何校正,加强了结构一致性.

blocks.en: Table 2: Novel-view synthesis measured by FID. FID is used as a proxy metric between rendered interpolated views and the real-image distribution under the same evaluation protocol; lower scores indicate smaller distributional discrepancy.
blocks.zh: 表2:FID测量的小说-视图合成. FID被用作提供插图视图与同一评价协议下的真象分布之间的代用度量;分数较低表明分布差异较小。

blocks.en: Quantitative results are reported in Table 2 . Because exact ground-truth images at the interpolated camera poses are unavailable, we use the Fréchet Inception Distance (FID) as a proxy metric and compute the distributional distance between rendered interpolated-view images and real images from the input-view distribution. As shown in Table 2 , our method achieves lower FID scores than DGGT [ 19 ] under this protocol, suggesting better distributional consistency for interpolated-view rendering.
blocks.zh: 表2报告了量化结果。 由于内插相机姿势上没有准确的地面真实图像,我们使用Fréchet Inception District(FID)作为代用度量,并计算出所渲染的内插视图像与输入视分布的真实图像之间的分布距离. 如表2所示,在本协议下,我们的方法实现了比DGGT [19] 更低的FID分数,表明内插视图渲染的分布一致性更好.

blocks.en: Overall, these results suggest that more accurate depth estimation improves the spatial localization of Gaussian primitives, leading to stronger multi-view geometric consistency and higher-quality novel-view synthesis.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,这些结果表明,更精确的深度估计可以改善高斯原始物的空间局部化,导致更强的多视图几何一致性和更高品质的小说-观点合成.

blocks.en: 4.5 Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 4.5 阅读研究

blocks.en: The improvements in reconstruction quality mainly stem from two key components: the proposed Instance-Dynamic Consistency Constraint (IDC) and the LiDAR-guided depth estimation module. We therefore conduct targeted ablation studies to assess the contribution of these components through both quantitative metrics and qualitative visual comparisons. Additional ablation results are provided in Appendix B.2 .
blocks.zh: 重建质量的提高主要来自两个关键组成部分:拟议的实例-动态一致性约束(IDC)和LiDAR制导的深度估计模块。 因此,我们进行了有针对性的消化研究,通过定量计量和定性视觉比较评估这些组成部分的贡献。 附录B.2提供了额外的削减结果。

blocks.en: Table 3: Ablation study on the Waymo Open Dataset. Traffic-participant-region (TPR) metrics are computed on SAM3-generated traffic-participant masks, while full-image metrics are computed over all pixels.
blocks.zh: 表3:Waymo Open Datas集的读取研究. 交通-参与区域(TPR)的衡量标准用SAM3生成的交通-参与区域口罩计算,而全图像测量标准则用所有像素计算。

blocks.en: Figure 5: Qualitative ablation study. Replacing IDC-supervised dynamic-mask learning with a DGGT-initialized dynamic head reduces high-recall localization of traffic-participant regions, while replacing LiDAR-guided depth estimation with DPT-style depth prediction introduces geometric misalignment and degrades rendering quality.
blocks.zh: 图5:定性促销研究. 用DGGT初始化的动态头取代IDC监督的动态mask学习降低了交通参与区域高召本地化,同时用DPT风格的深度预测取代LiDAR导深估计,引入几何错位,降解渲染质量.

blocks.en: We first evaluate the role of IDC in dynamic-mask learning. For the w/o IDC variant, we remove the instance-level semantic branch and the IDC loss. Instead, the dynamic-mask prediction head is initialized from the pretrained dynamic head of DGGT. This setting provides a strong DGGT-style dynamic-mask baseline under the same input, sampling, rendering, and reconstruction-loss protocol. Therefore, this variant evaluates whether the proposed potentially dynamic participant prior improves traffic-participant-region reconstruction beyond a pretrained dynamic-mask predictor.
blocks.zh: 我们首先评价IDC在动态任务学习中的作用. 对于w/o IDC变体,我们去掉实例级语义分支和IDC损失. 相反,动态-mask预测头是从DGGT的预训动态头开始初始化的. 这个设置在相同的输入,采样,渲染和重塑-损失协议下提供了一个强大的DGGT风格的动态任务基线. 因此,这一变式评价了拟议的潜在动态参与者是否超越预先训练的动态任务预测器,提前改进了交通-参与者-区域重建。

blocks.en: As shown in Table 3 and Fig. 5 , replacing IDC-supervised dynamic-mask learning with the DGGT-initialized dynamic head reduces TPR (traffic-participant-region) PSNR from 26.76 to 23.81 and TPR SSIM from 0.858 to 0.774. This suggests that a pretrained dynamic head alone is insufficient for high-recall localization of traffic-participant regions that are prone to dynamic-static leakage in driving scenes. In contrast, IDC transfers the potentially dynamic participant prior to dynamic-mask prediction, leading to improved traffic-participant-region reconstruction.
blocks.zh: 如表3和图5所示,用DGGT-初始化的动态头取代IDC监督的动态任务学习将TPR(流量-参与区域)PSNR从26.76降至23.81,TPR SSIM从0.858降至0.774。 这表明,仅靠一个预先训练的动态头不足以使交通参与区域高召本地化,这些区域在驾驶场中容易发生动态静态渗漏。 相反,IDC在动态任务预测之前转移了潜在的动态参与者,从而改善了交通-参与-区域重建。

blocks.en: We further evaluate the contribution of the proposed LiDAR-guided depth estimation module. The w/o LiDAR-guided depth variant replaces LiDAR-guided depth estimation with the DPT-style [ 37 ] dense-depth prediction strategy adopted in DGGT [ 19 ] , while keeping all other modules, input camera parameters and training settings unchanged. This variant isolates whether LiDAR-anchored Gaussian positioning improves reconstruction quality.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步评价拟议的LiDAR指导深度估计模块的贡献。 W/o LiDAR导深变体用DGGT [19]中采用的DPT式[37]密集深度预测策略取代LiDAR导深估计,同时保持所有其他模块,输入相机参数和培训设置不变. 这种变体隔离了LiDAR-anchored Gaussian定位是否提高重建质量.

blocks.en: The quantitative and qualitative comparisons demonstrate that replacing LiDAR-guided depth estimation with a DPT-style predictor substantially degrades reconstruction performance, reducing full-image PSNR from 29.51 to 25.20 and increasing LPIPS from 0.102 to 0.213. The degradation is especially noticeable around object boundaries and regions with complex occlusions, where inaccurate depth estimation accumulates geometric errors and deteriorates the final rendering quality. These results indicate that LiDAR-guided depth estimation provides more accurate and geometrically consistent Gaussian positions.
blocks.zh: 定量和定性比较表明,用一个DPT式预测器取代LiDAR制导的深度估计,大大降低了重建性能,将全图像PSNR从29.51降至25.20,并将LPIPS从0.102增至0.213. 这种退化在物体边界和有复杂遮蔽的区域特别明显,在这些区域,不准确的深度估计累积了几何误差,使最终渲染质量恶化。 这些结果显示,LiDAR制导的深度估计提供了更准确和几何一致的高斯位置.

blocks.en: Overall, the ablation studies validate the two main design claims of IGRecon4D. IDC primarily improves high-recall localization of traffic-participant regions by transferring the potentially dynamic participant prior to dynamic-mask learning, whereas LiDAR-guided depth estimation mainly improves LiDAR-anchored Gaussian positioning and full-scene reconstruction quality. Both the quantitative results in Table 3 and the qualitative comparisons in Fig. 5 show that these components address complementary failure modes.
blocks.zh: 总的来说,衰减研究验证了IGREcon4D的两个主要设计主张. IDC主要通过在动态任务学习前转移潜在的动态参与者,改善交通参与地区的高召本地化,而LiDAR制导的深度估计主要改善LiDAR-安克雷德高斯的定位和全景重建质量. 表3中的定量结果和图5中的定性比较都表明,这些组成部分涉及互补的故障模式。

blocks.en: 4.6 Zero-shot Evaluation on nuScenes
blocks.zh: 4.6 对nuScases的零镜头评价

blocks.en: To further evaluate the generalization capability of the proposed method, we conduct zero-shot experiments on the nuScenes [ 57 ] dataset. We compare our method with several representative feed-forward reconstruction approaches, including AnySplat [ 15 ] , STORM [ 18 ] , DGGT [ 19 ] , NoPo4D [ 39 ] and DrivingForward [ 38 ] .
blocks.zh: 为了进一步评价拟议方法的概括性能力,我们在nuScenes[57]数据集上进行零镜头实验. 我们把方法与几个有代表性的饲料前进重建方法进行比较,包括AnySplate [15],STORM [18],DGGT [19],NoPo4D [39]和驱动前导[38].

blocks.en: Table 4: Zero-shot reconstruction comparison on nuScenes. Models are evaluated without fine-tuning on nuScenes; traffic-participant-region (TPR) metrics are computed on traffic-participant masks.
blocks.zh: 表4 nuScens的零镜头重建比较. 对模型的评估没有微调nuScenes;交通-参与区域(TPR)的衡量标准是在交通-参与区域口罩上计算的。

blocks.en: The quantitative results are reported in Table 4 . Our method achieves the best TPR PSNR and TPR SSIM, suggesting stronger cross-dataset traffic-participant-region reconstruction. AnySplat obtains better full-image PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS, which suggests an advantage on static or background-dominated regions; however, its TPR metrics are substantially lower because it lacks an explicit mechanism for modeling per-frame participant regions. STORM, NoPo4D and DrivingForward suffer from noticeable texture degradation, while DGGT remains less accurate on traffic-participant regions. Our zero-shot visualization results on nuScenes are shown in Fig. 6 .
blocks.zh: 表4报告了定量结果。 我们的方法实现了最好的TPR PSNR和TPR SSIM,建议加强跨数据集的交通-参与区域重建. AnySplat获得更好的全图像PSNR,SSIM和LPIPS,这说明对静态或背景为主的区域有优势;然而,其TPR的度量标准却要低得多,因为它缺乏一个明确的每帧参与者区域建模机制. STORM、NoPo4D和DriverForward的纹理明显退化,而DGGT在交通参与地区仍然不太准确。 我们关于nuScens的零镜头可视化结果在图6中显示.

blocks.en: Figure 6: Qualitative zero-shot reconstruction on nuScenes. Without fine-tuning on nuScenes, IGRecon4D preserves traffic participants more reliably than feed-forward baselines.
blocks.zh: 图6:在nuScens上进行定性零镜头重建. IGRECON4 没有微调 D使交通参与者比向导基线更可靠。

blocks.en: Overall, IGRecon4D achieves the strongest zero-shot traffic-participant-region reconstruction quality on the unseen nuScenes dataset. These results suggest that the proposed method generalizes most clearly to traffic participants, which are the main regions prone to dynamic-static leakage in autonomous-driving reconstruction.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,IGREcon4 D在未见的nuScens数据集上实现了最强的零射流量-参与区域重建质量. 这些结果表明,拟议的方法最明确地向交通参与者概括,交通参与者是在自主驾驶的重建中容易发生动态静态渗漏的主要区域。

blocks.en: 4.7 Agreement with the Pseudo-label Teacher
blocks.zh: 4.7 与Pseudo-label教师的协议

blocks.en: We further evaluate whether the instance-level semantic branch provides a reliable potentially dynamic participant prior for IDC. This evaluation is not intended to establish a new state of the art in instance segmentation; instead, it verifies that the instance-level semantic branch can produce semantic masks of sufficient quality to supervise dynamic-mask learning. We compare the instance-level semantic branch with representative instance segmentation methods, including Mask2Former [ 58 ] , DVIS++ [ 59 ] , and VidEoMT [ 60 ] .
blocks.zh: 我们进一步评价实例一级的语义分支是否为国际数据中心提供可靠的潜在动态参与者。 这种评价的目的不是要确立一种新工艺,例如分解;相反,它核查实例一级的语义分支能够产生足够质量的语义面具,以监督动态任务学习。 我们比较了实例级语义分支与代表性实例分割方法,包括Mask2Former [58],DVIS++ [59],和VidEOMT [60].

blocks.en: Since the Waymo Open Dataset [ 52 ] does not provide manually annotated instance segmentation labels, we adopt the instance masks generated by SAM3 as pseudo instance annotations. We report mAP, mAP 50 , mAP 25 , PQ, and mIoU with respect to these pseudo annotations. Following the standard PQ evaluation protocol, pixels that do not belong to any instance are treated as the background class. The quantitative results are summarized in Table 5 .
blocks.zh: 由于Waymo Open Datas集[52]没有提供手动附加说明的实例分区标签,我们采用SAM3生成的实例口罩作为伪实例说明. 我们报告mAP,mAP 50,mAP 25,PQ,和mIoU这些伪说明. 按照标准的PQ评价协议,不属于任何实例的像素都被作为背景类处理. 表5汇总了量化结果。

blocks.en: Table 5: Agreement with the Pseudo-label Teacher. All methods are evaluated against SAM3-generated pseudo instance annotations on Waymo; the branch is used to provide IDC supervision rather than to serve as a standalone segmentation model.
blocks.zh: 表5:与Pseudo-label教师的协议。 所有方法都根据SAM3生成的Waymo上的伪实例说明来评价;该分支被用来提供IDC监督,而不是作为独立的分区模型.

blocks.en: As shown in Table 5 , specialized segmentation models can achieve higher mAP or PQ under this pseudo-label protocol. Nevertheless, the proposed instance-level semantic branch obtains competitive mIoU and produces coherent instance masks for traffic participants. More importantly, the ablation results in Table 3 show that using these masks through IDC substantially improves traffic-participant-region reconstruction, confirming their effectiveness as a prior rather than as a standalone segmentation output.
blocks.zh: 如表5所示,专用分块模型可在此伪标签协议下实现更高的mAP或PQ. 然而,拟议的实例层面语义分支获得了具有竞争力的mIoU,并为交通参与者生产了连贯的实例口罩。 更重要的是,表3中的减值结果显示,通过IDC使用这些口罩大大改善了交通-参与区域重建,证实了它们作为先前而不是单独分块产出的有效性。

blocks.en: Figure 7: Instance-level semantic predictions. The instance-level semantic branch is evaluated as a source of a potentially dynamic participant prior for IDC rather than as a standalone segmentation model; the predicted masks provide usable instance-level supervision for dynamic-mask learning.
blocks.zh: 图7:实例级语义预测. 实例层面语义分支在IDC之前被评价为潜在动态参与者的来源,而不是独立分块模式;预测的口罩为动态工作面具学习提供了可用实例层面的监督.

blocks.en: Qualitative comparisons of the predicted instance masks are presented in Fig. 7 , further showing that the learned semantic representations are sufficiently accurate to facilitate dynamic scene reconstruction.
blocks.zh: 图7对预测的实例口罩进行了定性比较,进一步显示所学的语义表述足够准确,便于动态场景重建。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: In this paper, we presented IGRecon4D, a feed-forward framework for dynamic scene reconstruction in autonomous driving scenarios. The key idea is to leverage instance-level semantic guidance and LiDAR-guided depth estimation in a feed-forward Gaussian reconstruction pipeline: the instance-level semantic branch provides a potentially dynamic participant prior for mask supervision, while LiDAR-guided depth estimation derives reliable Gaussian positions for LiDAR-anchored Gaussian positioning.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们介绍了IGREcon4D,这是在自主驱动情景中动态场景重建的向导框架. 关键的想法是在向导的高斯重建管道中,利用实例级语义指导和LiDAR导深估计:实例级语义分支为面具监督提供了潜在的动态参与者,而LiDAR导深估计则为LiDAR-anchored Gaussian定位获得可靠的高斯位置.

blocks.en: Experiments on the Waymo Open Dataset show that IGRecon4D improves full-image reconstruction quality over representative feed-forward baselines and yields clear gains on traffic-participant regions in the ablation study. Novel-view synthesis further supports the benefit of LiDAR-anchored Gaussian positioning for multi-view consistency. Under zero-shot evaluation on nuScenes, IGRecon4D achieves the best traffic-participant-region reconstruction metrics, although full-image metrics remain influenced by static and background-dominated regions.
blocks.zh: 在Waymo Open Dataset上的实验显示,IGREcon4D比有代表性的饲料前进基线提高了全图像重建质量,并在减速研究中取得了交通参与区域的明确收益. 小说-视野综合进一步支持LiDAR-anchored Gaussian定位对多视角一致性的好处. 根据对nuScenes的零镜头评价,IGREcon4D实现了最佳的交通-参与-区域重建指标,尽管全图像指标仍然受到静态和以背景为主的区域的影响.

blocks.en: The current framework is evaluated mainly with three front-facing cameras, sparse LiDAR input, and short video clips. Extending the method to longer temporal windows, broader camera configurations, and larger-scale scenes is an important direction for future work. In addition, the instance-level prior is semantic rather than motion-state supervision, and therefore cannot distinguish static and moving objects of the same category, such as parked and moving vehicles. Reducing training and inference cost would further improve its practicality for large-scale autonomous-driving reconstruction.
blocks.zh: 目前的框架评价主要有三台前置相机,少量的LiDAR输入,以及短视频片段. 将方法扩展至更长的时间窗口,更广泛的相机配置,以及更大的场景,是未来工作的重要方向. 此外,例级前是语义性而非运动状态监督,因此无法区分同一类的静态和移动物体,如停放和移动车辆. 减少培训和推断费用将进一步提高大规模自主驾驶重建的实用性。

blocks.en: B.1 Comparison with More Methods
blocks.zh: B.1 与更多方法的比较

blocks.en: We extend the comparison in Sec. 4.3 to EVolSplat4D [ 61 ] , IGGT [ 20 ] , and EPS3D [ 21 ] on the Waymo Open Dataset. EVolSplat4D takes both RGB and LiDAR as input, while IGGT and EPS3D jointly predict scene geometry and instance-level semantic information. Under the same RGB and LiDAR input conditions, our method outperforms EVolSplat4D on the reconstruction and geometric-consistency metrics in Table 6 . IGGT and EPS3D also obtain lower reconstruction quality in this driving-scene evaluation, suggesting that their predicted instance-level information does not sufficiently enhance geometric reconstruction in this setting. Fig. 8 provides qualitative comparisons.
blocks.zh: 我们在Waymo Open Dataset上将第4.3章中的比较扩展至EVolSplate4D [61],IGGT [20],以及EPS3D [21]. EVolSplate 4 (英语). D同时将RGB和LiDAR作为输入,而IGGT和EPS3D联合预测场景几何和实例级语义信息. 在同样的RGB和LiDAR输入条件下,我们的方法在表6中的重建和几何一致性度量标准上超过了EVolSplate4D. IGGT和EPS3D在本次驱动场评价中也获得了较低的重建质量,这表明他们预测的例级信息并不足以在此环境下加强几何重建. 图8提供了质量比较。

blocks.en: Table 6: Additional quantitative comparison on the Waymo Open Dataset. Metrics are computed on the validation split under the same input-view and input-frame setting for all methods. Traffic-participant-region (TPR) metrics are computed on SAM3-generated traffic-participant masks, while full-image metrics are computed over all pixels.
blocks.zh: 表6:Waymo开放数据集的进一步定量比较。 量度是根据所有方法的相同输入视图和输入框设置下的验证拆分法计算的。 交通-参与区域(TPR)的衡量标准用SAM3生成的交通-参与区域口罩计算,而全图像测量标准则用所有像素计算。

blocks.en: Figure 8: Qualitative comparison with additional methods on the Waymo Open Dataset. IGRecon4D better preserves traffic participants and static background details than feed-forward baselines, with fewer participant-region omissions and sharper object boundaries.
blocks.zh: 图 8:与Waymo Open Datas集上的其他方法进行定性比较. IGREcon 4 (希腊语) D比向导基线更好地保存交通参与者和静态背景细节,参与者-区域遗漏较少,对象界限更尖锐.

blocks.en: B.2 More Ablation Study Results
blocks.zh: B.2 更多的关联研究结果

blocks.en: Table 7 and Fig. 9 present three additional ablations of the dynamic-mask, geometric-input, and sky-rendering components. In the Directly using SAM3 variant, we run SAM3 [ 53 ] at inference and take the union of its predicted instance masks as the dynamic mask. The RGB input only variant receives RGB images without camera parameters or LiDAR measurements. The w/o sky gaussians variant omits sky Gaussians during rendering.
blocks.zh: 表7和图9列出了另外三个动态掩体、几何输入和天降组件。 在直接使用 SAM3 变体中,我们运行 SAM3 [53] 推论,并以其预测的实例口罩结合为动态口罩. RGB输入器仅接收RGB图像,没有相机参数或LiDAR测量. w/o天空gaussians变体在渲染时省略了天空高斯人.

blocks.en: Table 7: Additional ablation study on the Waymo Open Dataset. Traffic-participant-region (TPR) metrics are computed on SAM3-generated traffic-participant masks, while full-image metrics are computed over all pixels.
blocks.zh: 表7:关于Waymo Open Datas集的补充扩展研究. 交通-参与区域(TPR)的衡量标准用SAM3生成的交通-参与区域口罩计算,而全图像测量标准则用所有像素计算。

blocks.en: Figure 9: Additional qualitative ablation results. The examples compare IGRecon4D with RGB-only input, removal of sky Gaussians, and direct use of SAM3 masks.
blocks.zh: 图9:其他质量减损结果。 例子比较了IGREcon4D与只使用RGB的输入,删除天空高斯人,直接使用SAM3口罩.

blocks.en: As shown in Table 7 , directly using SAM3 yields reconstruction metrics close to those of our learned dynamic-mask predictor. However, calling SAM3 at inference increases the average runtime from 16.20 s for our method to 34.17 s, more than doubling the cost. With RGB input only, TPR PSNR drops to 22.06 and D-RMSE rises to 6.896, showing the value of the camera and LiDAR inputs for reconstruction. Omitting sky Gaussians sharply reduces full-image PSNR to 9.31 while leaving TPR PSNR at 25.72, indicating that the sky representation is particularly important for full-image rendering. Fig. 9 provides qualitative examples of these effects.
blocks.zh: 如表7所示,直接使用 SAM3 的重建指标与我们所学的动态任务预测指标接近。 然而,在推论中调用SAM3将平均运行时间从我们方法的16.20秒增加到34.17秒,成本翻了一番以上. 只有RGB输入,TPR PSNR下降至22.06,D-RMSE上升至6.896,显示了相机和LiDAR输入重建的价值. Omiting Sky Gaussians将全图像PSNR锐减为9.31,同时离开TPR PSNR为25.72,表明天空代表对全图像渲染特别重要. 图9提供了这些影响的定性实例。

blocks.en: B.3 Temporal Interpolation Results
blocks.zh: B.3 临时内插结果

blocks.en: We evaluate temporal interpolation by reconstructing and rendering a sequence of 21 consecutive frames from the front, front-left, and front-right cameras. For each camera, only frames 0, 5, 10, 15, and 20 are used as reconstruction inputs, while all 21 frames are used for evaluation. At every timestamp, we render the static Gaussians reconstructed from the input frames. At input timestamps, we use the dynamic Gaussians reconstructed from those frames. At intermediate timestamps, following DGGT [ 19 ] , we use pretrained TAPIP3D [ 62 ] to estimate dynamic-Gaussian trajectories between adjacent input frames and interpolate Gaussian positions and rotations along these trajectories.
blocks.zh: 我们通过从前部,左前部和右前部相机 重建并制造连续21帧的序列来评估时间插图。 每台相机仅使用帧0,5,10,15和20作为重建投入,而所有21帧用于评价. 每一次,我们都会让静态的高斯人 从输入框重建。 在输入时间戳上,我们使用由这些帧重建的动态高斯人. 在中间时间戳上,继DGGT [19] 之后,我们使用预训的TAPIP3D [62] 来估计相邻输入框和内插高斯位置之间的动态-高斯轨道以及沿着这些轨道的旋转.

blocks.en: Table 8 and Fig. 10 compare our method with DGGT under the same temporal-interpolation setup. Our method achieves better traffic-participant-region and full-image reconstruction metrics, as well as lower D-RMSE, consistent with its stronger dynamic-object reconstruction and geometric consistency.
blocks.zh: 表8和图10将我们的方法与DGGT在相同的时间插值设置下进行比较. 我们的方法实现了更好的交通参与区和全图像重建衡量标准,以及更低的D-RMSE,符合其更强的动态对象重建和几何一致性.

blocks.en: Table 8: Temporal interpolation comparison on the Waymo Open Dataset. Traffic-participant-region (TPR) metrics are computed on SAM3-generated traffic-participant masks, while full-image metrics are computed over all pixels.
blocks.zh: 表8:Waymo Open Datas集时间插值比较。 交通-参与区域(TPR)的衡量标准用SAM3生成的交通-参与区域口罩计算,而全图像测量标准则用所有像素计算。

blocks.en: Figure 10: Qualitative comparison of temporal interpolation results. Ground truth (GT), IGRecon4D, and DGGT are shown from left to right. Red boxes highlight regions where DGGT produces visible artifacts on traffic participants.
blocks.zh: 图10:时间插值结果定性比较. 地面真理(GT),IGREcon4D,和DGGT从左到右显示. 红盒突出DGGT在交通参与者身上生产可见文物的区域.

blocks.en: B.4 Evaluation of Predicted Dynamic Mask
blocks.zh: B.4 评价预测的动态面具

blocks.en: We further evaluate the quality of the dynamic masks predicted under IDC supervision. Using pseudo labels generated by SAM3 [ 53 ] as the reference, we compute the accuracy and recall of our predicted masks and compare them with those predicted by the baseline DGGT [ 19 ] . As shown in Table 9 and Fig. 11 , our method achieves higher accuracy and recall, indicating more reliable localization of potentially dynamic traffic participants in driving scenes.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步评价在国际数据中心监督下预测的动态口罩的质量。 使用SAM3[53]生成的伪标签作为参考,我们计算我们预测的口罩的准确性和召回性,并将其与基线DGGT[19]预测的口罩进行比较. 如表9和图11所示,我们的方法提高了准确度和召回率,表明在驾驶场景中潜在动态交通参与者的定位更加可靠。

blocks.en: Table 9: Evaluation of predicted dynamic masks. Accuracy and recall are measured against SAM3-generated pseudo ground truth; higher is better for both metrics.
blocks.zh: 表9:预测动态口罩的评价。 精确度和召回度以SAM3生成的伪地面真伪来衡量;两个度量标准都较高。

blocks.en: Figure 11: Qualitative evaluation of predicted dynamic masks. RGB images, SAM3-generated pseudo ground-truth masks, our predictions, and DGGT predictions are shown from left to right.
blocks.zh: 图11:预测动态口罩定性评价. RGB图像,SAM3生成的伪地面真面罩,我们的预测,以及DGGT的预测从左到右显示.

blocks.en: B.5 Failure Cases
blocks.zh: B.5 失败案件

blocks.en: Our method still struggles in challenging scenes with strong lighting effects. Fig. 12 shows a nighttime scene illuminated by streetlights. Although our reconstruction captures the approximate scene geometry, it does not adequately model the lighting. Consequently, the rendered image fails to reproduce the illumination cast by the streetlights, limiting the overall reconstruction quality.
blocks.zh: 我们的方法在具有强烈照明效果的具有挑战性的场景中仍然挣扎着. 图12显示了夜景 街道灯光照亮。 虽然我们的重建能捕捉到大概的场景几何,但是它并没有适当地模拟照明. 因此,制作的图像无法复制街灯的照明,限制了整体重建质量。

blocks.en: Figure 12: Failure case in a nighttime scene. Ground truth (GT) and our reconstruction are shown side by side. The red box highlights a visible reconstruction artifact.
blocks.zh: 图12:夜幕中的失败案例。 地面真相(GT)和我们的重建是并存的。 红匣突出可见重建文物.
